item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00226","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C22","C15","C09"],"selected_candidate_label":"C22","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C22 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the 1960 memorandum. Both use the same short sequence: announce the coming nationwide United Fund and Community Chest appeals and participating national charities; characterize federal personnel's obligation as assuming their full citizen's share; designate the Secretary of Defense as Vice Chairman for the Federal Government; and request cooperation and voluntary generosity. Several phrases are closely preserved, while the campaign total, officeholder, and descriptive details are updated. C15 and C09 are also closely related annual predecessors, but C22 is the latest and most textually proximate model.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Again this coming fall the United Community Campaigns will seek our support ... The American National Red Cross will be included in a number of these, along with other national organizations, such as the Salvation Army, the USO, the Scouts and the Y's.","parent_excerpt":"United Funds and Community Chests will make their annual appeals this fall ... Many of these campaigns will include such national agencies as the American National Red Cross, the United Service Organizations (USO)","explanation":"Both open by announcing the fall federated campaigns and identifying participating national charities."},{"child_excerpt":"We, in Government, must bear our full citizens' share in the great humanitarian efforts which advance the welfare of our fellow citizens and communities.","parent_excerpt":"We, in Government, want to assume our full citizen's share of this great charitable work.","explanation":"This is distinctive, closely shared language expressing the federal workforce's civic obligation."},{"child_excerpt":"The Honorable Thomas S. Gates, Jr., Secretary of Defense, has agreed to serve as Vice Chairman of the United Community Campaigns for the federal Government. He merits our heartiest cooperation.","parent_excerpt":"The Honorable Neil H. McElroy, Secretary of Defense, will serve as Vice Chairman of the United Community Campaigns for the Federal government throughout the country. I am confident everyone will cooperate gladly with him in these campaigns.","explanation":"The same appointment-and-cooperation provision is retained, with the successor Secretary of Defense substituted."},{"child_excerpt":"I know that Government employees will continue their fine record of voluntary giving.","parent_excerpt":"It is my hope that employees of your department ... will give thoughtfully and generously to these campaigns.","explanation":"Both conclude by urging federal employees' voluntary support of the campaigns."}]}
